entities.name: Wilhelm Gottlieb Hankel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wilhelm Gottlieb Hankel was a German physicist who was among the first to identify pyroelectric effects and the rotation of the plane of optical polarization in fluorspar upon application of electricity.
